PHYSICS — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Diodes 4.0 Environmental and Space Physics 4.1 Physics of wind formation 4.2 Int? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Diodes 4.0 Environmental and Space Physics 4.1 Physics of wind formation 4.2 Int.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Diodes 4.0 Environmental and Space Physics 4.1 Physics of wind formation 4.2 Int.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Diodes 4.0 Environmental and Space Physics 4.1 Physics of wind formation 4.2 Int.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Diodes 4.0 Environmental and Space Physics 4.1 Physics of wind formation 4.2 Int.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Linear Motion ● Terminologies used in linear motion. (distance, displacement, sp? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Linear Motion ● Terminologies used in linear motion. (distance, displacement, sp.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Linear Motion ● Terminologies used in linear motion. (distance, displacement, sp.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Linear Motion ● Terminologies used in linear motion. (distance, displacement, sp.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Linear Motion ● Terminologies used in linear motion. (distance, displacement, sp.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

13. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Linear Motion ● Terminologies used in linear motion. (distance, displacement, sp and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
